{{Top|leg}}
A '''fleet camp''' was an educational institution established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the first part of a recruit's training to join the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Fleet camps were scattered throughout the Empire. After a recruit successfully completed fleet camp, they attended advanced schools for specialized training in their assigned Naval branch.
